caption:
Quiet mornings in Tokyo, still in Shibuya 🌳
Stay on the park side.

🥇 Shibuya's north side, toward Yoyogi Park
🚶 Walk home from dinner. No last train.
🌅 Walk to the park in the morning.

🥈 Yoyogi-Hachiman, for early risers
🌳 Yoyogi Park is open all day and free.
⚠️ The catch: you change trains
at Shimokitazawa every night.

💡 Skip Yoyogi-Uehara for this.
It's mostly apartments, with very few hotels.
